rationale: This is a 3x inverse energy ETF in midday chop: it gapped down 2.78%, staged a full recovery above VWAP ($8.56), but has now stalled for ~15 minutes in a 3-cent band under $8.68, where the last higher-volume push (232k shares) was absorbed and faded. There is no catalyst, no historical analog, and the setup is symmetrical — a long is chasing 1.3% off the high with a seller overhead, while a short fades an intraday uptrend holding above VWAP; with no resolution in either direction, expected value is roughly zero and the disciplined choice is to stand aside.
